chat.channelsSubtitle: Connect messaging channels to receive customer messages right inside your CRM.
chat.selectConversationDesc: Choose a chat from the list to view messages.
chat.chatClosed: This chat is closed. Reopen it to reply.
chat.deleteMsgConfirm: Delete this message? This only removes it from your CRM, not from the messenger.
chat.webhookHint: Paste this into the platform's webhook settings. Requires public HTTPS — works in production, not on localhost.
chat.noVerifiedDomainBody1: Email channel reuses the domain you've already verified for sending OTP codes. Open
chat.noVerifiedDomainBody2: and finish DKIM/SPF/DMARC verification, then come back here.
chat.dnsMxHint1: Add this MX record to your domain so incoming mail reaches our servers. Any address at this domain
chat.noSetupDesc: Web Chat uses your project's existing API credentials. Click Connect and the support widget will appear on every page of your storefront.
chat.lockedToDomain: Locked to your verified email domain
chat.lockedHint1: Locked to your verified email domain. To change it, update the domain in
chat.customerWillSee: Customer will see in their inbox

webchat.desc: Embed a support widget on your website. Customers chat anonymously.

telegram.desc: Connect a Telegram bot to receive direct messages from customers.

bot_token.label: Bot token
bot_token.hint: Talk to @BotFather on Telegram, create a bot, then paste the token here.

discord.desc: Connect a Discord bot to receive direct messages from users.

bot_token.label: Bot token
bot_token.hint: Discord Developer Portal → Applications → New App → Bot → Reset Token. Enable Privileged Gateway Intent: MESSAGE CONTENT.

whatsapp.desc: Receive customer messages via the WhatsApp Cloud API.

phone_number_id.label: Phone number ID
phone_number_id.hint: From Meta for Developers → WhatsApp → API Setup.

access_token.label: Permanent access token
access_token.hint: System User token with whatsapp_business_messaging scope.

verify_token.label: Webhook verify token
verify_token.hint: Make up any string. Paste the same string into Meta when subscribing the webhook.

app_secret.label: App secret
app_secret.hint: From your Meta App → Settings → Basic. Used to verify X-Hub-Signature-256.

instagram.desc: Receive Instagram Direct messages from your business profile.

page_id.label: Instagram page ID
page_id.hint: The IG Business Account ID linked to a Facebook Page.

access_token.label: Page access token
access_token.hint: Long-lived Page token with instagram_manage_messages scope.

verify_token.label: Webhook verify token
verify_token.hint: Used during the Meta subscription handshake.

app_secret.label: App secret
app_secret.hint: From your Meta App → Settings → Basic.

facebook.desc: Receive Facebook Messenger conversations from your Page.

access_token.label: Page access token
access_token.hint: Long-lived Page token with pages_messaging scope.

verify_token.label: Webhook verify token
verify_token.hint: Used during the Meta subscription handshake.

app_secret.label: App secret
app_secret.hint: From your Meta App → Settings → Basic.

viber.desc: Receive customer messages from your Viber bot.

auth_token.label: Auth token
auth_token.hint: Viber Admin Panel → Account info → Authentication token. Webhook URL is registered automatically when you have HTTPS.

x.desc: Receive Direct Messages from your X account.

bearer_token.label: OAuth 2.0 Bearer token
bearer_token.hint: X Developer Portal → Project → Keys and Tokens → Bearer Token. Requires Elevated access for DM endpoints.

handle.label: Account handle
handle.hint: For display only — used to label this integration.

app_secret.label: App secret
app_secret.hint: Consumer secret used to verify webhook signatures.

email.desc: Receive customer emails sent to any address @your-verified-domain. Replies are threaded.

domain.label: Verified email domain
domain.hint: Must be a domain you've already verified in Authentication → Email (DKIM/SPF/DMARC). Any address at this domain will be routed to this chat.

reply_local.label: Reply-from address
reply_local.hint: Local part only. Customer replies will land in the same chat regardless of this — this only controls what they see in the From field.

reply_name.label: Reply-from display name
reply_name.hint: Shown as the sender name in the customer's inbox. Leave blank to reuse the Auth Providers display name.

emails.resetConfirm: Reset this email to the default design?
emails.requiredWarn: This email must include {{vars}} — changes won't save until you add it back.
emails.broadcastsHint: Send a campaign to all your customers — now or on a schedule.
emails.noCampaigns: No campaigns yet. Create your first broadcast.

editor.noBlocks: No blocks yet — add one below.
editor.canvasHint: Paste an image (Ctrl+V) or drop an image / PDF anywhere here.
editor.selectBlock: Select a block to edit it.
editor.bgNote: Style the email panel and the page behind it — each can have its own colour and image.

dynamicNote.code: Renders the live verification code at send time.
dynamicNote.order_summary: Renders the order items and total at send time.
dynamicNote.downloads: Renders digital download links at send time (digital orders only).
